Maharashtra.sourceTitle: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Education Fee Scholarship Scheme

female.title: Possible Maharashtra female fee benefit
lines: Official Maharashtra scholarship pages list 100% tuition fee and exam fee benefit for eligible girls in professional courses from academic year 2024-25.
Eligibility still needs Maharashtra domicile, family income up to Rs 8 lakh, eligible scheme/category such as EBC/EWS/SEBC/OBC as applicable, and admission through the competent CAP process.
Do not subtract hostel, mess, deposit, bond, NRI, or management/institution-level fees unless the official fee order confirms it.

male.title: Possible Maharashtra male fee benefit
lines: Official Maharashtra scholarship pages list 50% tuition fee and exam fee benefit for eligible boys in professional courses under the income-linked scheme.
Eligibility depends on Maharashtra domicile, family income up to Rs 8 lakh, eligible category/scheme, and CAP admission route.
The predictor keeps full fees visible until documents are verified, because reimbursement is scheme approval, not automatic college fee reduction.
